title: Juicy Flaky Mexican Beef Sopes
description: A traditional Sonoran dish featuring salty, flaky sopes topped with juicy beef, whipping cream, and fresh ingredients, perfect for a romantic dinner
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat
Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute
Stir in the whipping cream and bring the mixture to a simmer
Reduce the heat to low and let the mixture cook while preparing the sopes
Warm the sopes shells by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds
Assemble the sopes by spooning the beef mixture onto a shell, followed by a sprinkle of shredded cheese, diced tomato, and chopped cilantro
